attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "Adds a new deserialization path (dictionary->JObject->ContentEventContext) that changes behavior when workflow input is re-hydrated as a dictionary, and now throws InvalidCastException for any other unexpected type instead of silently ignoring it, which could break existing workflows that previously worked with null/other input shapes."}

reason: Adds a new deserialization path (dictionary->JObject->ContentEventContext) that changes behavior when workflow input is re-hydrated as a dictionary, and now throws InvalidCastException for any other unexpected type instead of silently ignoring it, which could break existing workflows that previously worked with null/other input shapes.
